# Truthout

> Fearless independent nonprofit journalism dedicated to exposing social injustice, political corruption, and human rights violations.

Truthout is a nonprofit news organization committed to independent investigative journalism on issues including immigration, Palestinian liberation, US politics, and global human rights. The site serves as a platform for accountability journalism and activism-oriented reporting.

## Key Topics

- Independent Journalism
- Social Justice
- Immigration & ICE
- Palestinian Liberation
- Gaza Conflict
- Human Rights
- US Politics
- Political Accountability
- Nonprofit News
- Activism
- Political News
- West Bank
- Israel-Palestine
- Financial Transparency

## About & Mission

- [About Truthout](https://truthout.org/about): Truthout's nonprofit mission and commitment to independent journalism focused on social justice and political accountability
- [Truthout Homepage](https://truthout.org): Main news hub featuring fearless independent journalism on social justice, politics, and human rights

## Support & Donations

- [Make a Donation](https://truthout.org/donate): Support Truthout's nonprofit independent journalism through donations and financial contributions
